page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top, page number at top left. Marginal line numbers (5, 10 ... 35) in the right margin. A catchword at the lower right. Full-width text throughout.

main_text.l: Deut.18.verf.10. Non inuenitor in te diuinam, diuinationes,
praestigiator, & augur, neq; maleficus, neque incantator, neque in-
terrogans Pythonem, neq; magus, neque quaerens a mortuis. Abo-
minatio enim Iehoua est, qui facit haec. Vide historiam Saulis
1.Petri 5.v.8.9. Sobrij estote & vigilate. Nam aduersarius ve-
ster diabolus, &c. Vide num. praeced. 14. & ibid. Ephes. 6. verf. 11.
Matth. 17. v. 21. Hoc verò genus daemoniorum non egreditur
nisi per precationem & ieiunium. Confer Marc. 9. v. 29.
Etc. 16. verf. 41. Vigilate & orate, ne introeatis in tentatio-
nem. Confer Marc. 13. v. 13.
Iacob. 4. verf. 7. Resistite diabolo, & fugiet a vobis. Confer
Matth. 4. verf. 11.
LOCVS X.
De gratia primi hominis.
1. Homo à Deo conditus fuit bonus.
Gen. 1. v. 27. Itaq; creauit Deus hominem ad imaginem suam;
ad imaginem, inquam, Dei creauit eum.
Eccles. 7. v. 29. Deus fecit hominem rectum.
2. Gratia animae in homine protoplasto erat sa-
pientia & iustitia originalis, hoc est, natura-
liter propaganda.
Coloss. 3. v. 10. Induite nouum illum hominem, qui renoua-
tur in agnitionem (Dei) secundum imaginem eius, qui creauit eum.
Eph. 4. v. 24. Induite nouum illum hominem, qui secundum
Deum conditus est in iustitia & sanctitate vera.
3. Gratia corporis in primo homine erat immor-
talitas & eximia pulchritudo, vtraque natu-
raliter propaganda, hoc est, pendens à iure
creationis.
Gen. 2. v. 17. Nam quo die comederis deo, vtiq; morituru[?] es.

page.notes: The marginal numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 are line numbers printed in the right margin; they are recorded as notes at the lines they stand beside. The number 15 stands beside the heading LOCVS X. and is placed after it. "morituru[?] es" is doubtful: the final letters are hard to read at this resolution. The printed "Et cap." at the foot is taken as the catchword.
